do.text: Use a select for five or more options that need not all show at once.

dont.text: Don't hide two options behind a sheet: a switch or a radio group shows both in one look.

do.text: Turn on `searchable` (or use a combobox) once the list runs past a screenful.

dont.text: Don't make people scroll through 120 rows to find one.

do.text: Pass `error` with a sentence that says how to fix it; screen readers announce it.

dont.text: Don't mark the field red with `invalid` alone: colour by itself tells no one what to do.
